def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    full_employment_gdp = 1.3  # trillion dollars
    actual_gdp = 1.2  # trillion dollars
    mpc = 0.8

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    gdp_gap = full_employment_gdp - actual_gdp
    fiscal_multiplier = 1 / (1 - mpc)
    government_expenditure_increase = gdp_gap / fiscal_multiplier
    answer = government_expenditure_increase * 1000  # convert trillion dollars to billions

    # return answer
    return answer
